s0.ru: Есть {n} подстановок чисел от 1 до {m}. Запись — образы 1, 2 и дальше по порядку: {listing}. Сначала применяется первая подстановка, затем вторая и так далее. Куда переходит число {k}?
s0.en: There are {n} permutations of the numbers from 1 to {m}. Each entry lists the images of 1, 2, and so on: {listing}. The first permutation is applied first, then the second, and so on. Where does {k} go?

s1.en: There are {n} permutations of the numbers from 1 to {m}. Each entry lists the images of 1, 2, and so on: {listing}. The first permutation is applied first, then the second, and so on. What is the parity of the composition? Answer 0 if it is even and 1 if it is odd.
